title: File Format for Salary TDS File - Form Number 138 (24Q)  - Q1 to Q3 (Version 1.1) for Tax Year 2026-27 onwards

notes.text: File should be generated in ASCII Format with "txt" as filename extension.
Each Record (including last record) must start on new line and must end with a newline character. Hex Values : "0D" & "0A".

The constant values as mentioned in the file format below (values of fields viz. 'Record Type', 'Upload Type' etc.) need to be mentioned  In BLOCK letters only. i.e.. value of field 'Record Type' in case of 'File Header' should be specified as 'FH' and not 'fh'.

For all amount fields decimal value with precision of 2 should be provided e.g. 1000.50, 2345.00. It may be noted that in case of certain amount fields where fractional portion is not allowed, the value should contain decimal point followed by two zeros i.e. value - 2345 will not be allowed, whereas value - 2345.00 will be allowed.
For Rate at which tax Deducted (DD), decimal with precision value 4 should be provided e.g. if the rate is 2 then the same should be mentioned as 2.0000
M indicates mandatory field and  O indicates - Optional.
All dates should be in 'ddmmyyyy' format. No date should be a future date.
This is a ^ delimited variable field width file. This means that in case of empty spaces there is no need to provide leading '0' for numerals and trailing spaces for character fields.

The total number of delimiters (i.e. "^") in any type of record should be one less than the total number of fields in the respective record. For example the total number of fields in "File Header record" is 16, hence the total no. of delimiters in 'File Header record' would be 15.
Nil challans/transfer vouchers need to mandatorily have deductee records with flag  'A' or 'B' in the remarks for lower or non-deduction.
It is mandatory to import .csi file downloaded from TIN website (under Challan Status Inquiry tab) to verify the correctness of Challan details mentioned in the statement.
TAN & TAN name present in TDS Statement should match with TAN & TAN name present under .csi file downloaded from TIN website.
Changes/ Updates done in the file format is highlighted in green.
At least one deductee/collectee details should be mentioned in regular statement. Statements with zero/no deductee/collectee details should not be allowed to validate through FVU.

fields.name: Deductor Address3 (Road/Street/Block/Sector)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 3 of the Employer. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Deductor Address4 (Area/locality)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 4 of the Employer. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Deductor Address5 (District)

fields.name: Deductor's Address - State
fields.remarks: Numeric code for state. For list of State codes, refer to the Annexure 1 below.

fields.name: Deductor Email ID
fields.remarks:
Valid E-mail  should be provided.
1. Email format must be checked -atleast @ and '.' should be mentioned. 
2. Both @ and '.' should be preceded and succeeded by atleast one character.
3. At least one '.' should come after '@'.
4. All printable characters allowed except '^' and space.
5. This field is mandatory if no value is provided under field no. 42 i.e. "Responsible Person's Email ID -1" of Batch Header.
 E-mail id of deductor/deductor or person responsible for deducting/collecting tax should be provided.

fields.name: Deductor Contact Country Code
fields.remarks: Country calling code for deductor contact number (e.g., 91 for India).

fields.name: Deductor Contact Number
fields.remarks: Deductor contact number without country code; digits only. Max 10.

fields.name: Deductor   Type

fields.name: Name of Person responsible for Deduction
fields.remarks: Mention the Name of Person responsible for collecting tax on behalf of the deductor. Only blank values or only special characters or only dots, spaces etc. (i.e. `~!@#$%^&*( )_+,./?;:’”[{]}\|) are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Designation of the Person responsible for Deduction
fields.remarks: Mention the designation of Person responsible for collecting tax on behalf of the deductor. Only blank values or only special characters or only dots, spaces etc. (i.e. `~!@#$%^&*( )_+,./?;:’”[{]}\|) are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Address1 (Flat/Door/Block number)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 1 of the responsible Person. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Address2 (Post Office)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 2 of the responsible Person. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Address3 (Road/Street/Block/Sector)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 3 of the responsible Person. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Address4 (Area/locality)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 4 of the responsible Person. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Address5 (District)
fields.remarks: Mention the address line 5 of the responsible Person. Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person's State
fields.remarks: Numeric code for state. For list of State codes, refer to the Annexure 1 below.

fields.name: Responsible Person's Email ID -1
fields.remarks:
Valid E-mail  should be provided.
1. Email format must be checked -atleast @ and '.' should be mentioned. 
2. Both @ and '.' should be preceded and succeeded by atleast one character.
3. At least one '.' should come after '@'.
4. All printable characters allowed except '^' and space.

fields.name: Responsible Persons country region
fields.remarks: Mention the country of the responsible person . Only special characters are not allowed under this field.

fields.name: Responsible Person Contact Country/Region
fields.remarks: Country calling code for person responsible contact number (e.g., 91).

fields.name: Responsible Person Contact Number

fields.name: Batch Total of - Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan
fields.remarks: Mention the Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan.The value here should be same as sum of values in field 'Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan'  in the 'Challan Detail' record ( please refer to the Challan Detail' record section below ).  Paisa Field (Decimal Value) of the Amount must be 00.

fields.name: Count of Salary Details  Records (Not applicable)
Batch Total of - Gross Total Income as per Salary Detail (Not applicable)
Whether regular statement for Form 138 filed for earlier period
fields.remarks: "Y" if regular statement for Form 138 has been filed for earlier period, else value "N" should be provided.

fields.name: State Name
fields.remarks: Numeric code for state should be mentioned as per Annexure 5. Mandatory if deductor type is State Govt. (code S), Statutory body - State Govt. (code E), Autonomous body - State Govt. code H) and Local Authority - State Govt. (code N). For other deductor category no value should be provided.

fields.name: Ministry Name
fields.remarks:
Numeric code for Ministry name should be provided. For list of Ministry name codes, refer to the Annexure 3 below. Mandatory for following deductor types:
Central Govt (A), Statutory body - Central Govt. (D) & Autonomous body - Central Govt. (G). Optional for deductor type Statutory body - State Govt. (E), Autonomous body - State Govt. (H), Local Authority - Central Govt. (L) & Local Authority -State Govt. (N). 

For other deductor type no value should be provided.

fields.name: Ministry Name (Others)

fields.name: PAN of Responsible Person
fields.remarks: Quote ten digit valid PAN of the person responsible (as quoted in field no. 33 above) for deducting tax.

fields.name: Account Office Identification Number (AIN) of PAO/ TO/ CDDO
fields.remarks:
Mandatory to mention value only in case the deductor category is "Central Govt." or "State Govt." and mode of deposit of TDS/TCS is through 'Book Entry' i.e., value in the field no. 13 of challan/ transfer voucher details is "B". Mention AIN of the below:
1) Pay and Account Office (PAO)
2) Treasure Office (TO)
3) Cheque Drawing and Disbursing Officer (CDDO)

fields.name: Goods and Service Tax Number (GSTN)
fields.remarks: Mention 15 digit valid Goods and Service Tax Number (GSTIN).

fields.name: Count of Section 194P Detail Records (Not applicable)
Batch Total of - Gross Total Income as per Section 194P Detail (Not applicable)

CD.heading: TDS Statement for Salary category (Challan Detail Record)

fields.name: Line Number
fields.remarks: Running sequence number for each line in the file

fields.name: Record Type
fields.remarks: Value "CD" (Challan Detail) for Challan Detail record

fields.name: Batch Number
fields.remarks: Value should be same as 'Batch Number' field in 'Batch Header' record.

fields.name: Challan-Detail Record Number (Sl no. of the form)
fields.remarks: Running serial number for 'Challan Detail' records in a batch. Should start with 1

fields.name: Count of Employee/Deductee / Party Records
fields.remarks: Count of total number of 'Deductee Detail Records' within e-TDS statement. Value Should be  >= 0

fields.name: NIL Challan Indicator
fields.remarks: Value should be "N". In cases where no tax has been deposited in bank, value should be "Y" (applicable in case of NIL return)

fields.name: Total tax Deducted
fields.remarks: Mention the amount of "Income Tax" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total Interest
fields.remarks: Mention the amount of "Interest" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total fee
fields.remarks: Mention the amount of "Fee" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total Penalty
fields.remarks: Mention the amount of "Penalty" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

fields.name: Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan/Total Amount adjusted through Book Adjustment (Total of values in B+C+D+E)
fields.remarks:
Mention the amount of 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value. 
Value in this field should be equal to total of values in column numbers B, C, D, E.

In case of challan (i.e. value under field 13 is C), value in this field should be greater than or equal to:
Total tax deposited amount (field no. 25 of all deductee details mapped to corresponding challan) + Interest allocation (field no. 24 of challan details) + Other allocation (field no. 25 of challan details) + Fee amount (field no. 10 of challan details)

In case of transfer voucher (i.e. value under field 13 is B), value in this field should be greater than or equal to:
Total tax deposited amount (field no. 25 of all deductee details mapped to corresponding challan) + Interest allocation (field no. 24 of challan details) + Other allocation (field no. 25 of challan details)

fields.name: Mode of payment of tax (by way of challan/by way of book adjustment)
fields.remarks:
Allowed values C or B
If Transfer Voucher Number is provided this is mandatory and only allowed value is 'B'. If Bank Challan Number is provided , then mention value as "C". For a Nil statement no value to be provided.

fields.name: Last BSR Code/ Form 24G Receipt Number ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
BSR Code/ Form 24G Receipt Number
fields.remarks:
In case TDS deposited by 
1) Challan:BSR Code of the receiving branch
2) Book Adjustment: Quote seven digit receipt number provided by AO. Applicable for govt. deductor/ deductor where TDS is deposited by book entry. 
3) No value to be quoted in case of Nil Statement (value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" field is "Y").

fields.name: Last Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number
fields.remarks:
Challan Number issued by Bank if value in field G is C
DDO Serial Number if value in column G is B
 Applicable to both Govt and Non Govt, Non-Nil statements.  No value is required to be provided in case of a NIL return (I.e. the cases in which the value in field 'NIL Challan Indicator' is "Y").

fields.name: Last Date of 'Bank Challan No / DDO Serial Number' ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Date of 'Bank Challan / Transfer Voucher' (DDMMYYYY)
fields.remarks:
Date of payment of tax to Govt. It can be any date on or after 1st April of immediate previous financial year for which the return is prepared. Value should be equal to last date of respective quarter if the value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" is "Y". 
Date of 'Bank Challan / Book Adjustment' should be within the respective quarter for which statement is being filed, in case of minor head code value selected under field no. 23 is '100'. Also this date has to be on or before date present under field 'Date on which Amount paid / Credited' field no. 19 of DD record (which is mapped to this challan with minor head code value '100')

fields.name: Last Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Total Tax Deposited Amount as per Employee/Deductee annexure  (Total Sum of column no.L) for the specified challan
fields.remarks: Mention the sum of  'Deductee Deposit Amount' of the underlying Deductee Records

fields.name: Total Tax Deducted Amount as per Employee/Deductee annexure (Total sum of Column no. J) for the specified challan
fields.remarks: Total sum of tax deducted of the deductee details for the respective Challan

fields.name: Minor Head of Challan
fields.remarks: Mention value as marked on challan - refer Annexure 7 for minor head

fields.name: Interest Allocation
fields.remarks: Mention interest allocation. Only integer values are allowed. The value of 1000 should be represented as 1000.00 in this field. Mention value as provided in field no. 9 of CD details.

fields.name: Others Allocation
fields.remarks: Mention fees allocation. Only integer values are allowed for this field. The value of 1000 should be represented as 1000.00 in this field. Mention value as provided in field no. 11 of CD details.

DD.heading: TDS Statement for Salary category (Deductee Detail Record)

fields.name: Line Number
fields.remarks: Running Sequence Number for each line in the file

fields.name: Batch Number
fields.remarks: Value should be same as 'Batch Number' field in 'Batch Header' record

fields.name: Deductee / Party Detail Record No
fields.remarks: Running serial no to indicate detail record no.

fields.name: Challan reference Number
fields.remarks: Running serial number for 'Challan Detail' records in a batch.

fields.name: Last deductee PAN ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Deductee's PAN
fields.remarks: PAN of the Employee. If available should be Valid PAN Format. There may be Employees who have not been issued PAN however who have applied for a PAN and have given adequate declaration to the deductor indicating the same.  In such cases, deduction schedule in the statement will not reflect PAN and instead state PAN Ref. Number for the Employee.  The deductor will however have to mention ‘PANAPPLIED’ in place of PAN. If the Employee is not sure of the PAN format he will have to mention 'PANINVALID'.  However if the Employee has not given any declaration, deductor will have to mention ‘PANNOTAVBL’ in place of PAN.

fields.name: Name of the Employee
fields.remarks: Mention the Name of the Employee.

fields.name: Whether the total amount of tax deducted as mentioned in Column (J) has been deposited (Yes/No)
Date of payment / Credited (dd/mm/yyyy)
fields.remarks: Date on which Amount paid/ Credited /Debited to deductee. The value under the “Date of Payment / Date on which Amount Collected / Debited” field shall fall within the quarter and financial year to which the statement pertains·

fields.name: Amount Paid/ Credited
fields.remarks: Mention the Amount paid to Employee. Value should always be greater than 0.00

fields.name: Total Tax Deducted
fields.remarks: Value in this field should be equal to Total Tax Deposited in field no. 25 (pertaining to deductee details).

fields.name: Total Tax Deposited
fields.remarks: Mention the Total Tax Deposited for the Deductee. Value in this field should be equal to Total Tax deducted mentioned in field no. 24 (pertaining to deductee details) .

fields.name: Last total Tax deducted (Used for Verification) (Not Applicable)
Date of deduction (dd/mm/yyyy)
fields.remarks: Date of tax deduction. Mandatory  if 'Total tax deducted' is greater than Zero (0.00) . No value needs to be specified if 'Total Tax Deducted' is Zero (0.00) . Date to be mentioned in DDMMYYYY format. Also, this date should not be less than the relevant quarter. E.g. If the statement is being prepared for Q2 of Tax Year 2026-27, then date of deduction should be greater than or equal to 01/07/2026.

fields.name: Date of deposit (dd/mm/yyyy)
fields.remarks: Date of tax depoist. Mandatory if 'Total tax deposited' is greater than Zero (0.00). No value needs to be specified if 'Total Tax Deposited' is Zero (0.00) . Date to be mentioned in DDMMYYYY format.

fields.name:
Reason for non-deduction
/lower deduction/higher deduction
fields.remarks: If applicable quote value (code) as per Annexure 6 else no value to be provided.

fields.name:
Certificate number(s) of the certificate under section 395(1)
issued for non-deduction /lower deduction
fields.remarks: Mandatory to mention 10 or 15 digit alphanumeric value if, "A" is mentioned in field no. 32 (Remark field).
